text:
anna: Quick sync from the DR postmortem — I pulled out the recurring cascade patterns and a tight set of follow-ups we should track. Need owners and short ETAs so we can schedule the next game-day rehearsal.

mike: I can take multi-region routing validation (AWS ALB + GCLB flows). ETA EOW for smoke tests. Will need a perm route table diff and traffic shaping knobs.

sofia: I'll own backup verification and snapshot recoveries. Plan: run full snapshot restore to staging on Thu, validate data integrity, then do a partial restore test on Fri. ETA Fri COB for test results.

raj: tagging myself for restore runbook edits — I'll consolidate the steps that failed in the postmortem and add explicit validation points. Target Monday sprint for PR.

elena: Note: we found an edge case where KV cache warmup causes 30s surge after failover — I'm on it to add a pre-warm step to the runbook. ETA next Wed.

tim: I'll coordinate game-day scheduling and ops rotations. Propose 2-hour slot next Tuesday 10–12 PT. ops-bot, can you create a calendar poll?

ops-bot: poll created: "DR game-day rehearsal — 2hr slot (Tue)" — vote here: https://calendar.internal/poll/3199990001

mike: Quick question — for the ALB -> regional fallback path we added last quarter, do we want to keep sticky session draining or always cut? Suggest graceful drain + 60s grace window.

sofia: Graceful drain + 60s sounds right for stateful endpoints. For backups, I'm adding a checksum validation step: `pg_dump --format=custom` + `pg_restore --list` verification.

anna: +1 on both. Raj, when you edit the runbook, please add explicit commands and expected outputs for the restore verification so Sofia can reference them.

raj: Will do. Draft checklist I'll add:
```
1) Snapshot verify: list snapshots, check tags
2) Create test volume: `aws ec2 create-volume --snapshot-id $SNAP`
3) Attach & mount, run `sha256sum` against manifest
4) Boot test instance and run app smoke tests
```

elena: Also adding a telemetry checkpoint — during game-day we should flag a `dr_test` metric so Optimize doesn't batch aggressively and skew latency.

tim: Who can own the failover telemetry annotation? I can do the dashboard tile but need someone to push the metric flag during the rehearsal.

mike: I can add a temporary toggle in routing-service to emit `dr_test=true` on header-based routed traffic. Quick PR today.

sofia: For the partial restore test, I'll need a small dataset and a synthetic traffic generator. @anna can you approve a short budget for the staging infra? Should be < $200.

anna: Approved. Use the "postmortem-rehearsal" billing tag. Keep it tight.

raj: FYI: I'll also add a rollback decision tree section to the runbook so on-call has clear abort points and owner handoffs.

tim: Game-day ops rota: Anna (lead), Mike (routing), Sofia (data/restore), Elena (runtime), Raj (runbook), Tim (coord).

ops-bot: calendar event created: "DR cascade pattern rehearsal" Tue 10:00–12:00 PT, attendees: anna,mike,sofia,elena,raj,tim

mike: I'll post the ALB route diff and a short smoke test script in the thread later today.

sofia: Will post the restore verification script and sample manifest after my snapshot run tomorrow.

anna: Great — can everyone update the central spreadsheet with owner, ETA, and acceptance criteria by EOD today? Link: https://docs.internal/dr-rehearsal/owners

elena: Updated my line.

raj: Added runbook PR target + checklist.

mike: Routing tests scheduled Thu morning.

sofia: Snapshot restore to staging done — minor permission issue fixed, full results in thread tomorrow.

anna: Thanks all. We'll close this loop in the EOD sync and lock the game-day. If anything slips, call it out here so we can re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
